projects.name: HRMS — Human Resource Management System
details: HRMS — Human Resource Management System
• Improved legacy code and MongoDB query performance by adding indexes and removing nested loops, cutting report generation time
from 5 minutes to 25 seconds for 1 lakh (100,000+) records.
• Implemented Go concurrency patterns (Worker Pool, Fan-In/Fan-Out) for background PDF and Excel report generation.
• Resolved Kubernetes pod crashes from high-memory jobs using controlled goroutine execution and gopsutil-based memory checks,
improving scalability under load.
• Integrated Elasticsearch/Kibana dashboards and alerting; built AWS S3 file upload, encryption, and pre-signed URL features.
• Developed an Expense microservice with approval workflows and Tesseract OCR-based receipt data extraction.

projects.name: Freight Management System — Microservices
details: Freight Management System — Microservices
• Implemented gRPC-based inter-service communication and a Kafka-driven event system for real-time parcel tracking.
• Built event deduplication logic and used Cadence workflow orchestration for retrying and reprocessing failed events.
• Generated freight bills and shipping labels via ZPL, and implemented fuel-price and carrier-discount business rules.
• Used PostgreSQL for transactional data and Cassandra for high-volume tracking events; managed schema migrations.
• Applied dependency injection (samber/do) to reduce coupling; wrote unit/integration tests using a TDD approach.
